<reason>PRO won by neutralizing CON's two live routes — fragility and capacity — while keeping exclusion-as-default as the deciding clash. CON's surge retreated to slow strain and its funding-as-fees claim was met by tax-base plus scarcity-dilution, whereas PRO's scale-defenders and 50-vs-50000 lots points were never squarely answered.</reason>
